subject.title: Legacy google provider block fails current model-catalog schema (missing api, input audio/video, cost.cacheWrite) → provider silently unavailable + 120s idle timeout on fallback

question: Which open Google legacy-provider migration PR should be the canonical landing path, and should the fallback idle-timeout behavior remain tracked separately before this issue closes?
rationale: Automation should not choose among multiple viable overlapping PRs or decide whether the issue closure scope includes the separate runtime fallback symptom.

options.title: Choose one migration PR and split fallback tracking
options.body: Land the strongest Google-owned migration PR, remove duplicate landing paths, and keep or create a narrow follow-up for unavailable-model fail-fast/fallback behavior.

options.title: Broaden the chosen PR
options.body: Require the selected PR to also fix the unavailable-model timeout/fallback behavior before it closes this issue.

options.title: Accept scoped closure
options.body: Treat the migration as sufficient to close this issue and intentionally leave the fallback timeout behavior untracked or lower priority.

recommendation.title: Choose one migration PR and split fallback tracking
recommendation.body: Land the strongest Google-owned migration PR, remove duplicate landing paths, and keep or create a narrow follow-up for unavailable-model fail-fast/fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent adjacent provider/auth ownership history and is a practical owner for the canonical PR and closure-scope decision.
